my_lead: DP6: abstract 'DP6 exhibited the most potent anti-proliferative activity' and DP6 is the compound used for the Western blot follow-up

reactions.issue: Product written as free amine; isolated as TFA salt oil used crude: acceptable.
4f correctly listed twice (2.5 eq used, two amide bonds); PDS 1 eq.

leaf_issues: PDS: the only support is the blanket 'All reagents and solvents were obtained commercially' (Chemistry section) plus the introduction describing PDS as a clinically used derivative of andrographolide; PDS is never said to be purchased specifically. Acceptable under the blanket-statement rule; potassium salt in the paper, free diacid drawn. Fluorothalidomide is printed as 'Fluoro-thalidomide' with no regiochemistry; 4-fluoro inferred from the products (4-aminoisoindoline-1,3-dione), certain.
notes: Checked: 3f (39.4%, N-Boc-1,8-diaminooctane replaces N-Boc-1,2-diaminoethane, DIPEA, DMF, 90 C), 4a-f TFA/DCM deprotection 'requiring no further purification, used directly', DP1 amide procedure (PDS 1 eq, amine 2.5 eq, EDCI 2 eq, HOBt 3, DIPEA 3, DMF, rt 12 h), DP6 'followed the same procedure as DP1, replacing 3f with 3a' (a typo for the octyl amine; DP6 name and HRMS C70H88N8O16 [M+Na]+ 1319.6210 fit two 8-aminooctyl chains: C28H36O10 diacid + 2 x C21H28N4O4 - 2 H2O balances exactly). Traced the DP6 SMILES: dehydroandrographolide core (C4 Me + CH2O, C3-O, C8 exocyclic methylene, C11=C12 alkene, butenolide) with one succinamide at C19 and one at C3, correct. Stereo omitted from SMILES (name carries it); thalidomide centre racemic. 3 steps from commercial. PDS is a marketed drug substance bought in, not isolated by the authors.
